title: The PR view carries only what this PR changes: base-relative plan-store findings, no plan-step nag when an objective is named, a capped file list
acceptance_criteria: a PR that leaves the plan store's standing state alone gets no plan-store finding from it; a PR naming an objective is not asked which plan step it moves; a component lists at most 30 files and summarizes the rest; no rendered truncation splits a UTF-8 rune

title: Every branch is asked for its objective: the pre-edit hook reminds an unclaimed branch once per session, and a bead id in the branch name claims it
acceptance_criteria: the first edit on a branch with no objective in a session gets a one-time reminder naming the claim command; a branch named after a bead resolves to it and the commit-msg hook stamps it; a claimed branch is never reminded

title: In a repo where merge is review, merging a PR ratifies the knowledge it proposes
acceptance_criteria: with ratify: merge, a PR that adds a proposed record gets a finding telling the agent to ratify it in the PR, and the PR view shows each record added to the store with its decision and rejected alternatives so the merge is an informed approval
